skills.es: Agrega y analiza riesgos del portafolio de proyectos: riesgos correlacionados y exposición sistémica.

skills.name: environmental-monitoring
skills.en: Monitor environmental conditions on construction sites. Track air quality, noise levels, vibration, dust, and weather to ensure compliance and worker safety.
skills.es: Monitorea condiciones ambientales de obra: aire, ruido, vibración, polvo y clima, para cumplimiento.

skills.name: equipment-telematics
skills.en: Integrate and analyze telematics data from heavy construction equipment. Track location, utilization, fuel consumption, maintenance needs, and operator behavior.
skills.es: Integra y analiza telemetría de maquinaria pesada: ubicación, utilización, combustible y mantenimiento.

skills.name: generative-ai-design
skills.en: Generative design for construction: text-to-BIM concepts, option generation, and AI-assisted design iteration with cost and carbon feedback. Use when exploring early design options with AI.
skills.es: Diseño generativo para construcción: conceptos de texto a BIM, generación de opciones y retroalimentación de costo y carbono.

skills.name: ifc-data-extraction
skills.en: Extract structured data from IFC (Industry Foundation Classes) files using IfcOpenShell. Parse BIM models, extract quantities, properties, spatial relationships, and export to various formats.
skills.es: Extrae datos estructurados de archivos IFC con IfcOpenShell: cantidades, propiedades y relaciones.

skills.name: labor-productivity-analytics
skills.en: Analyze construction labor productivity using data analytics. Track worker performance, identify inefficiencies, predict resource needs, and optimize crew allocation for maximum efficiency.
skills.es: Analiza productividad laboral con analítica de datos: desempeño, ineficiencias y necesidades de recursos.

skills.name: material-passports-circular
skills.en: Material passports and circular construction: generate per-element material inventories from BOQ/BIM, mark reuse potential and recycled content, and prepare deconstruction data. Use for circular-economy and EU Taxonomy-aligned projects.
skills.es: Pasaportes de materiales y construcción circular: inventarios por elemento, potencial de reúso y contenido reciclado.

skills.name: material-tracking-iot
skills.en: IoT-based material tracking for construction sites. Monitor material delivery, storage conditions, usage, and inventory with sensors, RFID, GPS, and real-time dashboards.
skills.es: Seguimiento de materiales con IoT: entrega, almacenamiento, uso e inventario con sensores y RFID.

skills.name: n8n-workflow-automation
skills.en: Build no-code/low-code automation workflows for construction using n8n. Automate data extraction, cost estimation, report generation, and system integrations without writing code.
skills.es: Construye flujos de automatización sin código con n8n: extracción de datos, estimación e informes.

skills.name: open-construction-estimate
skills.en: Access and utilize open construction pricing databases. Match BIM elements to standardized work items, calculate costs using public unit price databases with 55,000+ work items.
skills.es: Usa bases de precios abiertas: asocia elementos BIM con ítems estandarizados y calcula costos con precios públicos.

skills.name: permit-tracking-automation
skills.en: Automate construction permit tracking and management. Monitor application status, track renewal deadlines, manage document requirements, and integrate with municipal systems.
skills.es: Automatiza el seguimiento de permisos: estado de solicitudes, vencimientos y documentos requeridos.

skills.name: portfolio-dashboard
skills.en: Multi-project portfolio analytics dashboard. Aggregate KPIs across projects, track portfolio health, compare performance, and support executive decision-making.
skills.es: Tablero analítico multiproyecto: agrega indicadores, salud del portafolio y comparación de desempeño.

skills.name: prefab-optimization
skills.en: Optimize prefabrication and modular construction workflows. Plan module sequencing, factory scheduling, transportation logistics, and on-site assembly for maximum efficiency.
skills.es: Optimiza flujos de prefabricación y construcción modular: secuencia de módulos, fábrica y logística.

skills.name: progress-monitoring-cv
skills.en: Monitor construction progress using computer vision. Analyze site photos and drone imagery to track work completion, detect safety issues, and compare against BIM models.
skills.es: Monitorea el avance con visión por computador sobre fotos de obra e imágenes de dron.

skills.name: resource-pool-optimizer
skills.en: Optimize shared resource pools across multiple construction projects. Balance resource allocation, minimize conflicts, and maximize utilization across the portfolio.
skills.es: Optimiza recursos compartidos entre varios proyectos: asignación, conflictos y utilización.

skills.name: risk-assessment-ml
skills.en: Apply machine learning for construction project risk assessment. Predict schedule delays, cost overruns, and safety incidents using historical data and project characteristics.
skills.es: Evaluación de riesgos con aprendizaje automático: retrasos, sobrecostos e incidentes de seguridad.

skills.name: safety-compliance-checker
skills.en: Automated safety compliance verification for construction sites. Check PPE usage, zone access, working at heights regulations, and generate compliance reports using rule-based and ML approaches.
skills.es: Verificación automática de cumplimiento de seguridad: uso de EPP, acceso a zonas y trabajo en alturas.

skills.name: sensor-data-aggregator
skills.en: Aggregate and analyze IoT sensor data from construction sites. Collect data from multiple sensor types, detect anomalies, and trigger alerts for safety and quality monitoring.
skills.es: Agrega y analiza datos de sensores IoT de obra: varios tipos, anomalías y alertas.

skills.name: site-logistics-optimization
skills.en: Optimize construction site logistics including material delivery scheduling, crane positioning, storage area allocation, and traffic flow using operations research and simulation.
skills.es: Optimiza la logística de obra: entregas, posición de grúas, áreas de almacenamiento y flujo de tráfico.

skills.name: weather-impact-analysis
skills.en: Analyze weather data impact on construction schedules. Predict weather delays, optimize work scheduling based on forecasts, and calculate weather-related risk factors for project planning.

skills.en: 4D scheduling and 5D cost modelling in OpenConstructionERP: build task schedules, link tasks to BIM elements and BOQ lines, roll up the cost model over time, and export Gantt/sequence views. Use for schedule-cost integration workflows.

skills.en: Tendering and reporting in OpenConstructionERP: prepare tender BOQs, compare bids, manage risks, and generate reports (weekly, monthly, closeout). Use when a project goes to tender or needs reporting.
skills.es: Licitación e informes en OpenConstructionERP: listas de cantidades para licitar, comparación de ofertas y riesgos.

skills.en: Use the OpenConstructionERP validation engine: rule packs (BOQ quality, DIN 276, NRM, GAEB, MasterFormat, DPGF) that check estimates at import time and on demand. Use when verifying BOQ correctness or writing custom validation rules.
skills.es: Motor de validación de OpenConstructionERP: paquetes de reglas (calidad de presupuesto, DIN 276, NRM, GAEB, MasterFormat).
